coverage.evidence: createBatch pre-validation; ac2 asserts the valid alias was not created

findings.issue: A batch consumes one token but creates up to 50 links: the create limit (30/min) becomes 1,500 links/min per client.
findings.suggestion: Consume tokens proportional to batch size (bucket.tryConsume(n)) or apply a separate batch limit.

findings.issue: Each entry is validated twice (pre-check and inside create()).
findings.suggestion: Acceptable for clarity; optimise only if profiling shows cost.

summary: Correct all-or-nothing semantics with good tests. One HIGH: rate-limit amplification through the batch endpoint.
